T16.text:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Have you ever looked at your ad account and thought, “I honestly have no idea if any of this is working”?

I hear this from wedding business owners all the time.

Sometimes they’re paying an agency every month. Sometimes they’re trying to manage their own ads.

Either way, they’re logging into their ad account, seeing data they can’t quite make sense of, and struggling to answer one simple question:

Did any of this actually lead to bookings?

I was talking with one of our Ads Accelerator clients recently, and she described exactly what that felt like.

During the first half of last year, her venue spent more than $22,000 on ad spend and agency fees.

Every month, they received reports showing impressions and clicks.

What they couldn’t see was whether those clicks were turning into inquiries or wedding bookings because there wasn’t even conversion tracking in place.

When leadership asked whether their advertising was working, there wasn’t a real answer.

Eventually, she decided to take advertising into her own hands.

She wanted to learn. She just didn’t want to figure it out alone anymore.

Together, we rebuilt the foundation.

We launched new campaigns, installed conversion tracking, and showed her how to create a landing page designed to convert the traffic her ads were generating.

Fast forward to the first half of this year: about $6,000 in ad spend has generated nearly $70,000 in wedding bookings directly attributable to her campaigns.

For clarity, that $6,000 is ad spend only, while last year’s $22,000 included agency fees.

The bookings matter. So does her ability to understand what’s producing them.

Now she can see which campaigns generate inquiries and connect those inquiries to booked weddings. And she has our team in her corner to help her interpret the data and decide what to do next.

That’s how we work with wedding pros inside the Ads Accelerators.

We build and launch your first campaigns, then guide you as you learn to manage them yourself. You’re doing the ongoing work, with experienced strategists helping you understand what’s working and where to refine.

If you’d like that kind of support for your venue or wedding business, reply and tell me a little about your experience with ads so far. I’d be happy to help you explore whether an Accelerator is a good fit.

Take care,
Whitney

T06.text:
SUBJECT: Slay Google Ads 💀
PREVIEW TEXT: A strong foundation makes Google Ads a lot less mysterious.

Happy Halloween, {{contact.first_name}}!

We love a classic scary movie. But when it comes to your Google Ads account, we’d rather you know exactly what’s happening.

And why it’s working.

If you’ve already built a strong brand, a beautiful website, and a great experience for your couples, Google Ads can help more of the right people find you when they’re actively searching.

Here’s what we focus on to turn that visibility into inquiries and bookings.

**Start with the right foundation.**

Your ads make a promise. Your landing page should follow through, showing couples why you’re a fit and making it easy to inquire. Even a beautiful website benefits from a clear, focused path to that next step.

**Have a seamless follow-up system.**

Once a couple inquires, the experience should feel just as thoughtful. A prompt response keeps the conversation moving. Automation can help you respond consistently, while personal follow-up helps couples feel understood.

**Build your campaigns around how couples search.**

Keyword research and campaign structure should reflect your services, location, and the searches that signal someone is looking for a business like yours. That gives your budget a clear purpose.

**Know what to look for.**

Clicks tell you people are visiting. Tracking inquiries helps you understand which campaigns are creating opportunities, so you can make informed decisions as your ads run.

That’s the approach we bring to the **Google Search Accelerator**.

We build your first campaigns for you, walk you through the strategy behind them, and provide guided support as you learn to manage and refine them yourself.

You’ll understand what’s running, what to watch, and how to decide what comes next.

Join our live info session on November 5 to see how it works and whether it’s the right fit for your business.

**[Register for the November 5 Live Info Session]**

Have a question you’d like us to cover? Hit reply and tell us.

XO,
Daniela & Whitney

T37.text:
:::writing{id="73184" variant="email" subject="The work that happens before we build your ads"}
I taught a training this morning that technically had nothing to do with running ads.

We were inside The VAULT with members of our Google Ads and Meta Ads Accelerators. And instead of talking about targeting, keywords, or campaign settings, we spent the workshop defining their unique value propositions.

Who are you particularly well suited to serve? What are those clients really trying to create through their wedding? What do you do especially well that actually matters to them?

And which things you’ve been calling “differentiators” are meaningful reasons to choose you, versus things that could be said by 20 competitors?

These questions shape what we say in an ad and what we emphasize on a landing page. They help us give the right couples a compelling reason to inquire.

This is the part of advertising that doesn’t happen inside the ad platform.

You can have a beautiful brand, a strong reputation, and years of experience serving couples, and still benefit from working through how to communicate what makes your business worth choosing.

You don’t need to have all of that figured out before joining us. It’s part of the work we do together inside the Accelerators.

And it’s one of the reasons the experience goes so much deeper than an online course.

We help you develop the strategy underneath your ads, clarify your messaging, and build your initial campaigns. Then we guide you as you learn to manage them, understand the data, and make decisions from it.

You’re building an advertising system around your business, with someone beside you who knows what that system needs to look like.

So when it’s time to put that strategy into practice, you have a campaign we’ve helped you launch and support as you learn. You’re never left with 47 videos and a blank Ads Manager staring back at you.

If you’ve been considering ads for your wedding business, what would you want help with first? Hit reply and let me know.

Whitney
:::
